import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));
        String line = br.readLine();
        int n = Integer.parseInt(line);
        if (n > 40) {
            pw.println(0);
            pw.flush();
            return;
        }
        List<Point> points = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            int a = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
            int b = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
            int c = Integer.parseInt(parts[2]);
            int d = Integer.parseInt(parts[3]);
            int e = Integer.parseInt(parts[4]);
            points.add(new Point(a, b, c, d, e));
        }
        if (n < 3) {
            pw.println(n);
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                pw.println(i);
            }
            pw.flush();
            return;
        }
        List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int center = 0; center < n; center++) {
            boolean found = false;
            for (int a = 0; a < n; a++) {
                if (a == center) continue;
                for (int b = 0; b < n; b++) {
                    if (b == center || b == a) continue;
                    Point A = points.get(a).minus(points.get(center));
                    Point B = points.get(b).minus(points.get(center));
                    if (A.dot(B)) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (found) break;
            }
            if (!found) result.add(center + 1);
        }
        pw.println(result.size());
        for (int id : result) {
            pw.println(id);
        }
        pw.flush();
    }

    static class Point {
        long a, b, c, d, e;
        Point(long a, long b, long c, long d, long e) {
            this.a = a; this.b = b; this.c = c; this.d = d; this.e = e;
        }
        boolean dot(Point rhs) {
            return a * rhs.a + b * rhs.b + c * rhs.c + d * rhs.d + e * rhs.e > 0;
        }
        Point minus(Point rhs) {
            return new Point(a - rhs.a, b - rhs.b, c - rhs.c, d - rhs.d, e - rhs.e);
        }
    }
}
